LanguageData.RHAH_Incident_LargeRefugeeWave_Descripti: A large group of ratkin refugees is approaching the colony, looking for food. With this many people, the next meal is no small matter.
LanguageData.RHAH_Incident_ThiefRatkinGroup_Descripti: A group of hungry ratkin thieves is approaching the colony. They may take food from here.
